lines.en: label chikadorm15:
: Hey, Chika. Are you in there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Chika。你在里面吗？

lines.en: I knock on Chika’s door and wait a moment before pressing my ear to it.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Chika 的门，等了一会儿，然后把耳朵贴上去。

lines.en: I can’t hear anything from inside the room and it’s not like her to just not answer so I guess...maybe she’s out?
lines.zh: 房间里一点动静都没有，她又不是那种会不吭声的人，所以我想……也许她出去了？

lines.en: That makes sense. I mean, she seems popular enough to be doing all kinds of-
lines.zh: 说得通。我是说，她看起来挺受欢迎的，肯定在忙各种各样——

lines.en: : Heya! Looking for me?
lines.zh: : 嗨！找我吗？

lines.en: scene castleredux1
Out of virtually nowhere, Chika shows up in the dorm and comes to a stop just several inches away from me.
lines.zh: Chika 不知从哪儿冒了出来，在宿舍里出现，停在我面前只有几英寸远的地方。

lines.en: if day < 6:
She’s still dressed in her uniform, so it’s probably safe to assume she's just getting back from school now for...whatever reason would have kept her late.
lines.zh: 她还穿着校服，所以大概可以断定她刚从学校回来，至于为什么拖到这么晚……原因不明。

lines.en: else:
She’s dressed in her uniform, which is kind of weird considering it's the weekend, but I'm going to go ahead and ignore that for the sake of moving things along.
lines.zh: 她穿着校服，考虑到今天是周末这有点奇怪，不过为了剧情顺利推进，我打算无视这一点。

lines.en: : Whatcha doing? Dropping by to visit?
lines.zh: : 干嘛呢？顺道来看我？

lines.en: : Yeah. Figured I’d stop by and see if you wanted to hang out since I didn't have anything else going on.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我想反正我也没别的事，就过来看看你要不要一起玩。

lines.en: : Hmmm...
: Hmmm what?
lines.zh: : 嗯什么？

lines.en: : Nothing. It's just that...well, I can’t hang out here right now.
lines.zh: : 没什么。只是……呃，我现在没法在这儿待着。

lines.en: : However...if you want to go on a little field trip, we could spend some time together. It would just require a little extra leg work.
lines.zh: : 不过……要是你愿意跟我走一趟，我们还能一起待会儿。就是要多走点路。

lines.en: : Well, like I said, it's not like I have anything else going on right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就像我说的，反正我现在也没别的事。

lines.en: if day < 6:
: I’m surprised you even showed up as early as you did. I feel like school ended just a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 你居然来得这么早，我还挺意外的。感觉学校才刚放学不久。

lines.en: else:
: I’m surprised you even showed up as early as you did. You're normally here a little later.
lines.zh: : 你居然来得这么早，我还挺意外的。你平常都更晚才来。

lines.en: scene castleredux2
: Glad I caught you when I did, though! Was beginning to wonder when I’d see you again.
lines.zh: : 不过还好赶上了！我正琢磨着什么时候才能再见到你呢。

lines.en: : The next[school] day is always a safe bet.
lines.zh: : 下一个[上学]日总是最保险的。

lines.en: scene castleredux1
: Oh, shut up. You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 哦，闭嘴啦。你懂我意思。

lines.en: : Lemme just run inside and grab my overnight bag really quick.
lines.zh: : 我进去拿下过夜的包，很快就好。

lines.en: : Overnight bag? Are you not staying in the dorm tonight?
lines.zh: : 过夜的包？你今晚不睡宿舍吗？

lines.en: scene castleredux2
: Nope! Stayin’ somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 不睡！去别的地方住。

lines.en: : Somewhere I was thinking would remain a secret a little while longer, but...oh well. I'm fine with you knowing.
lines.zh: : 本来想让那地方再保密一阵子的，但……算了。让你知道也没关系。

lines.en: scene castleredux3
: Besides, you’ve kinda already been there once before.
lines.zh: : 再说，你之前也算去过一次了。

lines.en: Once before?
lines.zh: 去过一次？

lines.en: Then...
lines.zh: 那么……

lines.en: : The second half of town?
lines.zh: : 城市的另一半？

lines.en: scene castleredux4
: The...what?
: I mean, I've never heard it called that before, but I think so?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我从没听人这么叫过，但应该是吧？

lines.en: : It's the same place I dragged you to the other night.
lines.zh: : 就是那天晚上我把你拽去的那个地方。

lines.en: : Do you have family living there or something?
lines.zh: : 你家里人住在那儿吗？

lines.en: scene castleredux5
: Well...yeah. But it's a liiiiittle more complicated than that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……对。不过这事有那么一丢丢复杂……

lines.en: : Do you mind if I just fill you in on the way? We’re gonna need something to talk about anyway since it’s a pretty long walk, so...
lines.zh: : 我路上再跟你说行吗？反正路挺长的，我们总得找点话说嘛，所以……

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sure. Go grab your bag and I'll just wait out here, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦，行。当然。你去拿包吧，我就在外面等。

lines.en: : Gotcha. Want a bottle of water or anything? Yumi has like six million of them, so I’m sure she won’t notice if we snag a couple.
lines.zh: : 明白。要不要拿瓶水什么的？Yumi 大概有六百万瓶，我们顺走几瓶她肯定发现不了。

lines.en: : I'll be fine. Just do what you need to do.
lines.zh: : 我不用。你忙你的就行。

lines.en: scene castleredux2
: Roger that! Be right back, then.
lines.zh: : 收到！那我马上回来。

lines.en: scene black
Chika is in and out of her room in no time at all and the two of us begin our journey to the second half of town.
lines.zh: Chika 进出房间快得很，我们俩随即动身前往城市的另一半。

lines.en: It kind of sucks that we won't get to be alone on account of her family being around, but-
lines.zh: 她家人在，我们没法独处，这有点扫兴，不过——

lines.en: Hey...wait a second.
lines.zh: 嘿……等等。

lines.en: Why did I just casually agree to meeting Chika's family?
lines.zh: 我刚才怎么就随口答应去见 Chika 的家人了？

lines.en: This isn't like me at all.
lines.zh: 这完全不像我会做的事。

lines.en: scene castleredux6
: Hey...Are you really okay with me meeting your family?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你真不介意我去见你家人？

lines.en: : Hm? Why wouldn't I be?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我为什么要介意？

lines.en: : Because I'm twice your age.
lines.zh: : 因为我年纪是你的两倍。

lines.en: : You're also my teacher. We could always use that as an excuse. Nobody needs to know we hang out in dressing rooms together and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你还是我的老师呢。我们随时可以拿这个当借口。没人需要知道我们一起在更衣室里待过什么的。

lines.en: : Besides, she’s probably sleeping right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说，她现在大概正睡着呢。

lines.en: Good. I've at least confirmed that Chika's mysterious family member is female- which makes sense given her dad walked out on her and most of the men here are missing anyway.
lines.zh: 好。至少我确认了 Chika 那位神秘的家人是女性——这说得通，毕竟她爸抛下了她，而这里的男人大多都不见了。

lines.en: But I still feel a little better going in knowing I'm not going to have to deal with some guy who would very easily see through my motives in spending time with this girl.
lines.zh: 不过知道不用面对某个能轻易看穿我接近这女孩动机的男人，我心里还是踏实了点。

lines.en: : Why would she be asleep right now? The sun hasn't even finished setting yet.
lines.zh: : 她这会儿为什么会睡着？太阳都还没完全落下去呢。

lines.en: scene castleredux7
: Boredom, probably. It's not like there's really much to do in our apartment.
lines.zh: : 大概是无聊吧。我们那间公寓里也没什么事可做。

lines.en: : Then why doesn't she leave?
lines.zh: : 那她为什么不出去？

lines.en: : That's...where it gets complicated.
lines.zh: : 这就是……复杂的地方了。

lines.en: scene castleredux8
: But that’s also why I’m staying there tonight! I’ve got some stuff I’ve gotta go over with her anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过这也是我今晚要住那儿的原因！反正我有些事得跟她商量。

lines.en: : Yumi was supposed to handle it this time, but-
lines.zh: : 这次本来该 Yumi 去处理的，不过——

lines.en: : Woah, hold on. Yumi?
lines.zh: : 哇，等等。Yumi？

lines.en: scene castleredux9
: Yeah. What's wrong with Yumi?
lines.zh: : 对啊。Yumi 怎么了？

lines.en: : Well...we're talking about a kid, right? That's at least what I'm starting to think based on all you've said.
lines.zh: : 呃……我们说的是个小孩，对吧？至少听你这么说，我是这么猜的。

lines.en: : We are, yeah. Do you think Yumi is bad with kids or something?
lines.zh: : 对，是小孩。你觉得 Yumi 不擅长带小孩还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I think Yumi is bad with everyone.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Yumi 跟谁都处不来。

lines.en: scene castleredux6
: Sensei, Yumi might be rough around the edges, but she isn't some kind of...demon.
lines.zh: : Sensei，Yumi 可能是不太好相处，但她又不是什么……恶魔。

lines.en: : Her family, on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 不过她家里人嘛……

lines.en: : Well, I guess that doesn’t matter right now. You ready to meet my little sister?
lines.zh: : 算了，现在说这个也没意义。你准备好见我妹妹了吗？

lines.en: : Ready as I'll ever be.
lines.zh: : 尽力准备好了。

lines.en: : Great. Before we go in, though, I do wanna warn you of something.
lines.zh: : 太好了。不过进去之前，我得先提醒你一件事。

lines.en: : She doesn’t bite, does she?
lines.zh: : 她不会咬人吧？

lines.en: : She hasn't yet. But she also hasn't been exposed to very many people, so I guess it's not, like, totally impossible.
lines.zh: : 目前还没咬过。不过她也没怎么接触过外人，所以我想也不是完全不可能啦。

lines.en: : Well, apart from the potential biting, what's the issue?
lines.zh: : 行，除了可能会咬人，还有什么问题？

lines.en: scene castleredux10
: She's, uhh...
: How do I say this?
lines.zh: : 该怎么说呢？

lines.en: scene castleredux11
: She’s...not really the strongest little girl out there. So don’t do anything that’ll get her too riled up, okay?
lines.zh: : 她……身体不算特别结实的小女孩。所以别做任何会让她太激动的事，好吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : She’s just got...really bad asthma and could have an attack if she over-exerts herself.
lines.zh: : 她就是……哮喘很严重，要是太用力的话可能会发作。

lines.en: : And like, I obviously know how to handle that and everything, but it can get really scary for both of us and...I’m sure you wouldn’t really want to be around for that...
lines.zh: : 而且我当然知道该怎么处理之类的，但那种时候我们俩都会很害怕，而且……我想你肯定不想碰上那种场面……

lines.en: : And, uhh, since we’re already on the topic, I guess I should also mention that she’s got a bit of a...compromised immune system as well.
lines.zh: : 还有，呃，既然都说到这儿了，我想我也该提一下，她的免疫系统也有点……弱。

lines.en: : So if you even think you might be sick, you should probably, like...just wait outside and let me figure something out.
lines.zh: : 所以你要是哪怕觉得自己可能生病了，最好就……在外面等着，让我想办法。

lines.en: : I obviously won’t make you wait out there for the rest of the day, but-
lines.zh: : 我当然不会让你在外面等一整天，不过——

lines.en: : I’m not sick. Don’t worry. Let’s just head inside and take things slow if it's really that serious.
lines.zh: : 我没生病。别担心。进去吧，真那么严重的话我们慢慢来就好。

lines.en: scene castleredux12
: Yeah.
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : It is...
lines.zh: : 确实是……

lines.en: scene black
: I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: scene hellochinami1
: Remember, don’t do anything that might rile her up.
lines.zh: : 记住，别做任何可能让她激动的事。

lines.en: : How exciting of a person do you think I am, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底觉得我是个多让人兴奋的人啊？

lines.en: The sound of a book slamming shut breaks our conversation before it's even built.
lines.zh: 一本书啪地合上的声音打断了我们还没真正开始的对话。

lines.en: It's followed by the sound of small feet, clapping against an old hardwood floor and steadily moving closer to the kitchen.
lines.zh: 紧接着是小小的脚步声，啪嗒啪嗒踩在旧木地板上，朝厨房稳步靠近。

lines.en: This is the symphony of a girl who will struggle to live in ways much different than you and I.
lines.zh: 这是一个女孩的交响曲——她将来要以跟你我截然不同的方式艰难地活下去。

lines.en: scene hellochinami2
An angel descends from on high.
lines.zh: 一位天使从高处降临。

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: The girl stares at me, expecting me to wave back.
lines.zh: 女孩盯着我，期待我也挥手回应。

lines.en: I attempt to lift my hand, but it appears that my muscle memory has decided to clock out for the evening.
lines.zh: 我试图抬起手，但我的肌肉记忆似乎决定今晚提前下班了。

lines.en: Both curious at my arrival and suspicious of who I am and why I’m here, she puts her hand down and looks at her sister.
lines.zh: 她既对我的到来感到好奇，又对我身份和来意存疑，于是放下手，看向她姐姐。

lines.en: scene hellochinami3
: Who is he?
lines.zh: : 他是谁？

lines.en: : Why were you two whispering?
lines.zh: : 你们俩为什么在说悄悄话？

lines.en: : Does Chinami need to whisper, too?
lines.zh: : Chinami 也要小声说话吗？

lines.en: : It’s okay, Chinami. You don’t have to whisper. I was just telling him a secret.
lines.zh: : 没关系的，Chinami。你不用小声。我刚才只是在跟他说个秘密。

lines.en: : A secret about what? Can you tell me next?
lines.zh: : 关于什么的秘密？下一个能告诉我吗？

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be a secret anymore if I told you.
lines.zh: : 我要是告诉你，那就不叫秘密了。

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene hellochinami2r
The girl looks at me again and, for the first time in a while, I can time the beating of my heart without having to press my hand against my chest.
lines.zh: 女孩又看了我一眼，而我很久以来第一次，不用把手按在胸口就能数出自己的心跳。

lines.en: All of the horrible things that fill this horrible part of town evaporate into thin air and rush out of the cracks in the window near the door.
lines.zh: 充斥着这片可怕城区的所有可怕事物都蒸发成稀薄的空气，从门边窗户的缝隙里涌了出去。

lines.en: I remember something.
lines.zh: 我想起了什么。

lines.en: Somewhere.
lines.zh: 某个地方。

lines.en: Somewhere just like this.
lines.zh: 某个和这里一模一样的地方。

lines.en: : Hello, sir. My name is Chinami Chosokabe and I am an ancient, powerful 5,000 year old Wizard.
lines.zh: : 你好，先生。我叫 Chinami Chosokabe，是一位古老而强大的五千年法师。

lines.en: : Ignore the wizard part, please. She says that to everyone.
lines.zh: : 法师那段请忽略。她对谁都这么说。

lines.en: : What’s your name?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字？

lines.en: : Chinami, this is my teacher. So you need to be good and make sure you don't do anything to get me in trouble, okay?
lines.zh: : Chinami，这是我的老师。所以你要乖乖的，别做任何会让我惹上麻烦的事，好吗？

lines.en: scene hellochinami4
: Why would something Chinami does get her big sister in trouble?
lines.zh: : 为什么 Chinami 做的事会让姐姐惹上麻烦？

lines.en: : Because that's just how the world works, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 因为这世界就是这么运转的，Chinami。

lines.en: : Chinami has had enough of this world.
lines.zh: : Chinami 受够这个世界了。

lines.en: scene hellochinami5
: Can you be Chinami's teacher, too? She's so bored all the time and has to read too many books!
lines.zh: : 你也可以当 Chinami 的老师吗？她整天都很无聊，还要读好多好多的书！

lines.en: : No, Chinami. He’s my teacher. You’re gonna have to keep putting up with Yumi and me until you’re ready to go to[school].
lines.zh: : 不行，Chinami。他是我的老师。在你能去[上学]之前，你还得继续忍耐 Yumi 和我。

lines.en: : But Chinami has no idea when that will be. She wants to learn now!
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 不知道那要等到什么时候。她现在就想学！

lines.en: : Then Chinami should get back to the worksheets big-sis Yumi printed out for her and-
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 就该回去做 Yumi 姐姐给她打印的练习册，然后——

lines.en: scene hellochinami6
: Are you my big sister’s boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 你是我姐姐的男朋友吗？

lines.en: : You don’t really look like a teacher.
lines.zh: : 你长得也不太像老师。

lines.en: : Ch-Chinami! That’s totally rude! You know I don't have a boyfriend! And that's not something you can just ask people you're meeting for the first time!
lines.zh: : Ch——Chinami！这太失礼了！你知道我没有男朋友的！而且这种事不能拿来问第一次见面的人！

lines.en: : Make sure you treat her super nice, okay?
lines.zh: : 你一定要对她超级好，好吗？

lines.en: : Big sis works super hard so that Chinami can go to[school] with the other girls someday.
lines.zh: : 姐姐超级努力地工作，就是为了有一天 Chinami 能跟其他女孩一样去[上学]。

lines.en: : Chinami! He's not my boyfriend!
lines.zh: : Chinami！他不是我男朋友！

lines.en: A situation I felt prepared for just minutes ago has managed to throw me into a state of utter shock.
lines.zh: 几分钟前我还觉得自己有所准备的局面，此刻却把我抛进了彻底的震惊之中。

lines.en: I don't think I've said a single thing since she's shown up and I can't even figure out why.
lines.zh: 她出现之后我好像一句话都没说过，我自己都说不清为什么。

lines.en: Is this really the secret that Chika’s been so desperately keeping from everyone?
lines.zh: 这就是 Chika 一直拼命对所有人隐瞒的秘密吗？

lines.en: I don't understand.
lines.zh: 我不明白。

lines.en: : Chinami, does anyone else take care of you? Or is it just your big sister?
lines.zh: : Chinami，还有别人照顾你吗？还是只有你姐姐？

lines.en: scene hellochinami7
: Chinami has two big sisters! Chika and Yumi!
lines.zh: : Chinami 有两个姐姐！Chika 和 Yumi！

lines.en: : And also the people who deliver Chinami food! They’re Chinami’s family, too!
lines.zh: : 还有给 Chinami 送吃的人！他们也是 Chinami 的家人！

lines.en: : She, uhh...likes to order from this one breakfast place in town since I’m not always here to cook in the morning...
lines.zh: : 她，呃……喜欢点镇上那家早餐店的外卖，因为我早上不总在这儿给她做饭……

lines.en: : Do you spend a lot of time alone, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你经常一个人待着吗，Chinami？

lines.en: scene hellochinami8
The girl shakes her head and looks directly into my eyes.
lines.zh: 女孩摇了摇头，直视我的眼睛。

lines.en: : Chinami is never alone!
lines.zh: : Chinami 从来不是一个人在！

lines.en: scene hellochinami9
The girl runs out of the kitchen and into the bedroom.
lines.zh: 女孩跑出厨房，冲进卧室。

lines.en: Chika falls silent and looks away as if she knows what's about to happen and understands that it's going to hurt her.
lines.zh: Chika 沉默下来，别开视线，像是知道接下来会发生什么，也明白那会刺痛她。

lines.en: But she presses on regardless, like a wild animal caught in barbed wire.
lines.zh: 但她还是硬撑下去，像一头被困在铁丝网里的野兽。

lines.en: I can hear a few things being moved around on a countertop.
lines.zh: 我听见台面上有几样东西被挪动的声音。

lines.en: Seconds later, the footsteps return.
lines.zh: 几秒后，脚步声回来了。

lines.en: But they’re so light it’s as if they barely exist in the first place.
lines.zh: 但那脚步轻得几乎像是根本不存在。

lines.en: scene hellochinami10
The girl runs back into the room with an old picture frame clutched in her tiny fingers.
lines.zh: 女孩跑回房间，小小的手指紧紧攥着一个旧相框。

lines.en: I already know who lives inside.
lines.zh: 我已经知道里面住着谁了。

lines.en: Chika’s reaction and the suppressed sounds of desperate gasps are more than enough to give it away.
lines.zh: Chika 的反应，还有那些拼命压抑的抽气声，已经足够说明一切。

lines.en: : Chinami is never alone because Mommy is always right here!
lines.zh: : Chinami 从来不是一个人在，因为妈妈一直就在这儿！

lines.en: : Chinami...put Mom away...we can't just..drag Sensei into our problems...
lines.zh: : Chinami……把妈妈收起来……我们不能就这么……把 Sensei 拖进我们的麻烦里……

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m sorry for crying...I told myself I wouldn't, but...
lines.zh: : Sensei……对不起我哭了……我跟自己说过不会哭的，但是……

lines.en: I have no idea what to do in situations like these. And despite an overwhelming lack of knowledge of where I come from, I think it's safe to say that I've been that way forever.
lines.zh: 这种场面我完全不知道该怎么办。虽然我对自己的来历一无所知，但我敢说我大概一直都是这样。

lines.en: But really, though- what is a person to do when spontaneously thrown into something as heavy as this?
lines.zh: 不过说真的——一个人突然被卷进这么沉重的事情里，能做什么呢？

lines.en: All I can do is let the weight of it crush me.
lines.zh: 我只能任由那份重量把我压垮。

lines.en: : Isn’t she pretty?
lines.zh: : 她很漂亮吧？

lines.en: Despite being the youngest of all of us, Chinami is the one who takes the reins and begins to steer away the awkward silence that had since filled the rundown apartment.
lines.zh: 尽管是我们当中最小的，Chinami 却是那个接过缰绳、开始驱散这间破旧公寓里尴尬沉默的人。

lines.en: Angels are real.
lines.zh: 天使是真的存在的。

lines.en: : She’s very pretty, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 她很漂亮，Chinami。

lines.en: : You both look a lot like her.
lines.zh: : 你们俩都长得很像她。

lines.en: scene hellochinami10r
: Sniff...Sniff...You...think so?
lines.zh: : 吸……吸……你……这么觉得？

lines.en: : Chinami thinks so too! She wants to look just like Mommy when she’s older.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也这么觉得！她长大了要长得跟妈妈一模一样。

lines.en: : And then she wants to marry a prince and live in a castle!
lines.zh: : 然后她要嫁给一位王子，住进城堡里！

lines.en: : They...sniff...don’t build castles anymore, Chinami...
lines.zh: : 现在……吸……已经不建城堡了，Chinami……

lines.en: : Then Chinami will have her prince build her one!
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 就让她的王子给她建一座！

lines.en: scene hellochinami11
: Just like you’ll build a castle for Chinami’s big sister.
lines.zh: : 就像你会给 Chinami 的姐姐建一座城堡一样。

lines.en: : I...uhh...don’t...really need a castle, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……呃……其实……不需要什么城堡，Sensei……

lines.en: : I'm fine...right where I am, so...we can just...I don't know...
lines.zh: : 我现在这样就挺好的，所以……我们可以就……我不知道……

lines.en: : I don't know anything...
lines.zh: : 我什么都不知道……

lines.en: I wonder what type of life I would have had to have led in order to build a castle for someone.
lines.zh: 我在想，一个人要过什么样的日子，才能为另一个人建起一座城堡。

lines.en: Most likely one that took place centuries ago...but still-
lines.zh: 大概要是生活在几百年前的那种……不过话说回来——

lines.en: Right now, I feel like castles are more than just colossal structures or set pieces in medieval movies.
lines.zh: 此刻我觉得，城堡不只是巨大的建筑，也不只是中世纪电影里的布景。

lines.en: Sometimes, a castle is just a place where you feel safe.
lines.zh: 有时候，城堡只是让你感到安心的地方。

lines.en: And even if Chinami never finds a fairy tale prince-
lines.zh: 就算 Chinami 永远找不到童话里的王子——

lines.en: I’m sure that someone will build her a castle some day.
lines.zh: 我相信总有一天会有人为她建一座城堡。

lines.en: And if they don’t, I will.
lines.zh: 如果没有，那我来建。

lines.en: I’ll build a castle for everyone.
lines.zh: 我要为所有人建一座城堡。

lines.en: : Chinami’s ancient wizard powers tell her that she should go into the bedroom now.
lines.zh: : Chinami 的远古法师之力告诉她，她现在该回卧室了。

lines.en: : But she’ll see you again!
lines.zh: : 但她还会再见到你的！

lines.en: : She can tell you’re a good person.
lines.zh: : 她看得出来你是个好人。

lines.en: : Please continue to be nice to her big sister.
lines.zh: : 请继续对她姐姐好。

lines.en: scene hellochinami12
The angel flies away without realizing the aftershock her wings cause.
lines.zh: 天使飞走了，浑然不觉她翅膀掀起的余震。

lines.en: : Well, uhh...this is embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 呃……这挺尴尬的。

lines.en: scene hellochinami13
: Chinami tends to make, umm...very strong first impressions...so I'm sorry if this was a little too much.
lines.zh: : Chinami 给别人留下的第一印象，呃……往往特别强烈……要是有点太过了，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Do I get bonus points for not riling her up?
lines.zh: : 我没让她激动，能不能加分？

lines.en: scene hellochinami14
: Hahah...You’ve been racking up a lot of those lately, haven't you?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……你最近攒了不少分呢，对吧？

lines.en: : Any idea of what you're going to cash them all in on?
lines.zh: : 想好要把它们兑换成什么了吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Maybe a castle.
lines.zh: : 也许是一座城堡。

lines.en: I don’t hang around much longer after that.
lines.zh: 那之后我没再久留。

lines.en: As it turns out, tonight is Chinami's homework night, so me being around would just serve as a distraction.
lines.zh: 原来今晚是 Chinami 写作业的时间，我待在这儿只会让她分心。

lines.en: I feel a little weird knowing that I, a professional teacher, am now viewed as a distraction when it comes to education, but I guess I understand.
lines.zh: 想到我这个职业老师，如今在教育这件事上反倒被视为干扰源，感觉有点怪，不过我大概能理解。

lines.en: Before I leave, Chika tells me about how she and Yumi have been homeschooling Chinami for a couple years now.
lines.zh: 临走前，Chika 告诉我，她和 Yumi 这两年一直在家里教 Chinami。

lines.en: Her immune system is bad enough to prevent her from going to[school] with the other kids her age.
lines.zh: 她的免疫系统太弱，没法跟同龄的孩子一样去[上学]。

lines.en: And without enough money for treatment, if there even is treatment, all she can really do is keep trying her best and hope to one day grow stronger...
lines.zh: 又没钱治病——如果有得治的话——她能做的就只有继续努力，盼着有朝一日能强壮起来……

lines.en: I'll be rooting for her.
lines.zh: 我会为她加油的。

lines.en: As hopeless as it may be.
lines.zh: 哪怕希望再渺茫。
